answer: The pulse test I would run is Bus driver CPC card with transport authority attestation: each card is periodic training hours logged by the transport authority, so a farm must train a hundred real drivers, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the lotus of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The falcon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
